challenge.decision_at_stake: whether the C2 flag stays on the vigabatrin and ketogenic-diet case series, what INV-10 may say about what a symptomatic response predicts about development, and the wording of CLAIM 001, 031 and 042
challenge.available_knowledge: six WWOX case reports read at complete or partial depth with verbatim locators; one five-patient diet series whose exposed denominator is not stated; two children with a vigabatrin MRI signal change known only from the abstract; UKISS at abstract level only
challenge.decisive_uncertainty: for how many patients a symptomatic and a developmental outcome are both recorded, and whether they move together more or less than in the comparable non-WWOX early-onset encephalopathies
challenge.discriminating_outcomes: counts of patients with both endpoints per intervention class with their concordance; the base rate of responder with unchanged development in IESS strata from primary trials
challenge.prior_work: IT18 P2 vigabatrin assertion table; IT29 P3-E (UKISS abstracts only, vigabatrin infantile-spasms literature not searched in depth); INV-10 next test never executed
challenge.resources: two Scientist readings, open full-text routes only
challenge.reevaluate_when: a WWOX cohort with per-patient therapy and developmental outcome is published, or the Choi 2026 full text states exposure denominators
challenge.reopen_reason: INV-10 asks for an assembly across reports that nobody assembled; two sources were read only at abstract or partial depth and the denominators are missing

challenge.decisive_uncertainty: whether risk concentrates in a stated age, duration and co-therapy window that WWOX-DEE infants fall inside, and whether a hypomyelinating baseline changes it
challenge.discriminating_outcomes: age and duration dependence and reversibility at full text; hormonal co-therapy as a confounder or not; any myelin-deficient baseline study
challenge.resources: one Scientist reading, open full-text routes only
